All first attempts. Fixed speed/cost bands; failures stay in the denominator. Qwen uses a prepaid-quota valuation, not cash billing.
*Free public access is not a metered $0 price or a promise of production capacity. New direct routes: October 20, 2026; earlier measurements unchanged.
Different providers, dates and account limits remain confounds. Rate/admission waits are excluded from response latency.
